# Washoe County Job Fair

> Northern Nevada's largest no-cost career fair, organized by Washoe County / EmployNV. Status as of publication: **postponed due to the Hawk Fire — a new date has not yet been set.**

## Key facts
- Cost: Free to attend, for both job seekers and employers.
- Location: Reno-Sparks Convention Center, 4590 S Virginia St, Reno, NV.
- Previously scheduled date: Monday, August 24, 2026, 11am–2pm (postponed; check the homepage for the new date).
- Scale: 90+ employers across health care, education, mining, skilled trades, manufacturing, logistics, hospitality, and government.
- What's offered: on-the-spot job offers, on-site career coaching, free job training resources, accessibility support.
- Contact: 775-284-9660 or biz-hub@detr.nv.gov.
- Registration: https://washoecountyjobfair.eventbrite.com/
- Related resource: EmployNV (https://www.employnv.gov/), an American Job Center of Nevada.

## Source of truth
The homepage (/) is the authoritative, up-to-date source for event status and the new date once announced. This file is a static summary and may lag behind the live page.
